caption: The drawing consists of three geometric, floral-like patterns and a pair of wavy lines, all rendered in a limited color palette of muted red, yellow, and blue on an off-white background that shows signs of aging. The largest pattern is positioned centrally and features a circular design with alternating red and blue petal-like forms bordered by red, with yellow segments in the middle and an inner circle containing yellow and blue shapes as well as a red-ringed circle with a cross inside. Above this central motif are two parallel, curved lines, each composed of red, yellow, and blue sections. Below the large central motif are two slightly smaller shapes: on the left is an eight-pointed star with alternating yellow and blue points, with red outlines and a yellow circle at the center; on the right is a flower-like motif with eight yellow petals bordered in red, a central blue ring of smaller petal shapes, and a striped yellow and red eye-like oval at the center, with small triangular blue marks placed between the outer petals. The patterns are symmetrical and rendered with clean lines. The background appears textured with darkened edges and two small dark holes near the upper corners.
title: San Juan Capistrano Mission Ceiling Decoration from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
